ValidationRule.description: This rule will restrict the HCM user to add Product of Interest on the creation of Opportunity record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c ) , TEXT( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ) <> "WX", ISNEW(), ISBLANK(NSP_Product_Interest__c) , $UserRole.DeveloperName = "HCM_Sales_Consultant", NOT( OR( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator" ) ) )
